hypothesis.statement: Requiring final Groom, skin, body and rigs before reviewing the conformed face wastes production effort when the MetaHuman still has the wrong or unattractive identity.
hypothesis.action: Add a head-only checkpoint immediately after conform with five fixed 1440x2560 neutral-gray views and a human keep/reject decision against canonical 03/06/07/08.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Incorrect faces return to Identity Solve before any production surface or Groom investment.

decisions.keep-and-build-surfaces: allowed only with zero blocking identity findings
decisions.reject-and-resolve-identity: valid checkpoint result; blocks skin, eye and Groom production

qualityBoundary: This checkpoint evaluates identity geometry early. It neither requires nor approves final skin, eyes, Groom, deformation, body, clothing, runtime performance or holographic quality.
decision: Do not start production surfaces until the user recognizes the face in all five fixed views.
